title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode20 Newly Edgy Idols

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's not just Minori's.
Our Untitled tracks are glowing too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that you've found your true feelings, they're about to give birth to a new song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Songs are all made of the true feelings within people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: True feelings? What do you mean, our true feelings?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It makes sense that you might not get it. After all, you've had them from the very beginning.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. Even when we were close to losing sight of ours, you always kept these feelings close.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The desire to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be the kind who gives hope to everyone around them. Those are my—no, those are our true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you. If it weren't for all of you, I wouldn't have been able to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Momoi, Shizuku, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And thank you so much, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, p-please, don't thank me!
Momoi and Hinomori had to help me the entire time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not true. You're the reason all of us were able to rediscover our true feelings, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. Thank you for helping us remember what was most important, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, it's because you took my hand and pulled me back up that I was able to reclaim this feeling.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka... Momoi... Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, what do you say we all sing this song together?! Do you mind if I join you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! Sing with Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Being able to sing with you would be wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! Why don't I get things warmed up as the MC, then! Let's put on a great show, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's sing together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That was my best performance yet!
Being an idol really is the best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wonder how long it's been since I felt like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really is a beautiful sight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? The name of the song changed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What? Oh, you're right! Let's see...
Newly Edgy Idols?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is this the song we just sang?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yep! It's the song born from everyone's feelings!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so fun and upbeat. A perfect song for looking forward to the future, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku. Rin. Thank you so much. Thanks to you, our feelings were finally able to reach Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Miku, Rin, thank you for giving me the push I needed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I have no way of thanking you enough.
I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That fact that you all found your feelings and sang them for us is more than enough to make us happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! Oh, but we hope you'll come back and sing for us again some time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. After all, this is your SEKAI. Come back and visit any time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Especially if you're ever feeling down!
We'll make sure to cheer you right back up♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Rin, you helped Airi and I when we needed it most. Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, Miku, Rin, that show we just did was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Would it be okay if we performed with you again sometime?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Of course!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'm going to become an idol again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really think that's what I'm meant to be.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: That's great. I'm so glad!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Does that mean you're going back to the agency? Or have you gotten an offer from somewhere else?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I actually haven't thought that far ahead.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I do have an idea...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Huh?
